newsitem.title: USA: Chevron Los Angeles crude unit shut -traders.
newsitem.headline: Chevron Los Angeles crude unit shut -traders.

text.p: Chevron Corp shut a crude distillation unit at its 260,000 barrel-per-day refinery south of Los Angeles over the weekend, traders said Thursday.
Four tankers were unable to unload crude at normal rates, according to traders who saw the ships waiting at the plant's harbor, located just south of Los Angeles in the Pacific Ocean.
The malfunctioning unit failed to influence local crude oil prices, which would normally fall in the case of a local supply glut.
The price of benchmark Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude rose slightly Thursday in line with higher futures values in New York.

Chevron's plant normally runs a heavy volume of imported crudes rather than domestic grades such as Californian Kern River (13 degrees American Petroleum Institute gravity) or ANS (27.9 degrees API gravity), traders said.
Chevron was not immediately available for comment.
